up: Retrieve the first 1000 activity rows from the activities table that match the following criteria: they are IC50 measurements (standard_type = 'IC50'), they have a pChEMBL value (pchembl_value IS NOT NULL), and they have an exact standard relation (standard_relation = '='). The activities must be linked to assays associated with the human single-protein target identified by ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL3473' (C-C chemokine receptor type 3). For each qualifying row, return the assay ChEMBL ID (assays.chembl_id), the target type (target_dictionary.target_type), the target taxonomy ID (target_dictionary.tax_id), the canonical SMILES (compound_structures.canonical_smiles), the molecule ChEMBL ID (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), the standard type (activities.standard_type), and the pChEMBL value (activities.pchembl_value). Order the results first by the molecule ChEMBL ID and then by the assay ChEMBL ID.
sql: WITH target_assays AS ( SELECT assay_id FROM assays WHERE tid = (SELECT tid FROM target_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3473') ) SELECT a.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, act.standard_type, act.pchembl_value FROM target_assays ta JOIN activities act ON act.assay_id = ta.assay_id JOIN assays a ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE act.standard_type = 'IC50' AND act.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_relation = '=' ORDER BY md.chembl_id, a.chembl_id LIMIT 1000;
